integrity: All universal claims follow from exact incidence counting and Euler's formula. The packaged checker only replays arithmetic and the finite partition step; no finite experiment is used as a proof of realizability or of an infinite statement.
scientific limitations: The theorem is purely combinatorial and assumes a closed orientable equivelar \(\{k,3\}\) surface with eight faces. The three-cycle-type conclusion additionally assumes that no face pair shares more than two edges. It does not prove geometric realizability of the remaining \(5+3\) type or classify embeddings.
title: Arithmetic rigidity at the minimal eight-face face-neighbourly level
